verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair question for an observability SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox org, test environment, or production-data isolation. LLM Observability Experiments, which version datasets and compare prompt and model changes, is an adjacent evaluation feature, not sandbox isolation from production, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
